questions.question: Google Sign-In requires a native module that fundamentally cannot run in Expo Go — only in a development build. How do you want to proceed?

options.label: Make Expo Go boot (guard imports)
options.description: Lazily import / guard google-signin & expo-notifications behind an Expo Go check so the app loads and you can iterate on UI/navigation. Trade-off: Google login and notifications will be no-ops in Expo Go (they'll only truly work in a dev build). Best for fast UI prototyping.

options.label: Switch to a development build
options.description: Install expo-dev-client and run a custom dev build (npx expo run:android / EAS). Google auth + notifications work fully. Trade-off: requires Android build tooling (may be awkward on WSL2) and is no longer 'Expo Go'.

options.label: Both
options.description: Guard the imports so Expo Go boots now, AND set up expo-dev-client so you can get full functionality when you build. Most work, but covers both workflows.
